title: Finite Primal Reserves
description: Mine Primal Ore in deep Overworld deepslate, the Nether or the End to recover Primal Shards, then store Primal Matter inside dedicated Primal Cells in a Matter Drive. Routine decomposition, synthesis and automation never drain Primal reserves.

Primal Matter funds Derive and Discovery steps in the Analyzer and feeds the Primal Converter. Every conversion requires a known solid element target and an explicit finite batch confirmation, so reserves cannot bleed away unattended.

Treat Primal Matter as a strategic catalyst for scarce inputs and research milestones rather than bulk metal production; native quarries, bees and processing chains remain better suited for high-volume commodities.
